summary: Genenta Science S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting that on June 15, 2026, it received Nasdaq notification confirming regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement (Listing Rule 5550(a)(2)). The company had been non-compliant since April 10, 2026, but demonstrated a closing bid price at or above $1.00 for ten consecutive business days (June 1–12, 2026). This is a routine listing compliance update, not a special situation. The filing involves no transaction, board action, or structural change. No terms, advisors, or risk-arb angles apply.
